recon_report.note: The recon report cites TB / statement cash, open AR/AP aging controls, and the journal digest already on the Operating book. A missing cite stays unset — never a silent reconciled-empty, a fake $0.00 that looks cleared, or empty-digest-as-success. Open AR/AP are context, never silent reconciling items. statements:read is the cite grant. books:read is optional membership listing.

recon_adjustments.note: The issue body still says journal:append. That string is an alias and is refused. Canonical: journals:post for already-seeded cash-moving Operating templates. Scenario journals post only when the operator opts in. Empty journals:post allowlist refuses every post. Closed-through refuses the batch. invoice_customer and vendor_bill do not move cash and are not recon adjustments.
